enemy.name: Sureness
enemy.flavour_text: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Life is always easier when there is spare meat and grain in the kitchen. Those who have known hardship are not above stealing to keep a stock of food.

abilities.text: Can collect up to 4 <Vapidity> or <Sapidity>; when full, moves towards <Derelict Stoves>
When defeated, spawns <Vapidity> equal to amount collected
